author: Nostrilman
quote:
I’d rate it at least 1-5 but many people who like it overreact and score a 10 either because they are deluding themselves that they’re having the good time they expected they’d have, or they’re giving it praise to show their allegiance and support to culture moving in a more emasculated direction.

GTA is in approximately the same world as goodfellas, sopranos, scarface, but with the aspect of being an absurdist parody on modern life, having a quick and crude, hilarious sense of humour and making a story feel quick, lively and genuinely rivalling of any major film.

In VI, Lucia is simply annoying, not in a bold or funny way like Trevor for example could be. Jason is so bland he would be more exciting had he been written by chat gpt. The Characters of gta have usually been so memorable and full of spirit that an entire cast can feel like each deserve a spin off. Here, it’s simply not the case.

The gameplay of gta in my opinion has long presented players with a unique, satisfying experience: do whatever bad thing we know you want to do. See car and think “I want to steal it.” See people “I want to shoot them” etc and gta has built its reputation on being THE game where no impulsive, nasty thought is off limits to act on. I know, you can do some of that stuff in VI however some cars can’t be stolen, some passengers have meltdowns that are designed to stall or prevent it and the game incentivises you to choose less violence. There is no sense like in every iteration before this that you can simply do anything that comes to mind. There is now a sense that you can, except there, there and there, oh and you can do that bad stuff, but you can get a reward for being nicey nice.

This kills the spirit of the franchise along with everything else mentioned.

This is not gta. This is the work of much lesser people than the original teams that brought you IV and V. It’s sold to you by using the reputation they built but with the actual content being an impressive graphics big mapped piece of ****.
